title: Perimenopause 101 — the 7-day rule (Asha, 43)
caption:
Cycles gone weird at 43? A 7+ day swing, month after month, is perimenopause — staged by your cycle log, not one FSH test (STRAW+10, 2012).
Send this to her.
Whose cycle changed first?
www.aiforheratx.org
#perimenopause #womenshealth #perimenopausesupport #cycletracking #hormonehealth

scenes.text: 43, and my cycles went *haywire*. Every lab came back normal.
Asha, 43, two kids and the school WhatsApp group. Everybody had a reason for it.
phrases: So I started writing down every start date.

scenes.text: A cycle that shifts by 7+ days, month after month, means the transition has already started.

scenes.text: New depression risk roughly *doubles* through this stretch, even with no history of it.
phrases: She thought she was cracking up.
New depression risk roughly *doubles* here — with no history of it.

scenes.text: Tonight: write down your last three period start dates. Tomorrow: a 30-minute walk.
phrases: Log every start date in your notes app.
Three months of dates is enough to stage it.
Calcium 1,000 mg + 600 IU vitamin D a day; 150 minutes of walking a week.
